note: Alberta Parks campground in the Milk River valley among the hoodoos at Writing-on-Stone / Áísínai'pi Provincial Park (UNESCO World Heritage Site), 32 km east of Milk River: shaded sites, a beach and river floating, pictographs and guided walks. The shower building opens in summer and takes loonies and toonies only; no ATM or cash-back in the park. --Claude

Wrote season May 15 - Nov 2 (replacing derived year_round), booking season, hookups, sites (59), facilities; note rewritten; website should be the campground page. On Esri imagery (0.73 m/px, cropped 2x) the cluster of sites at the south tip of the loop sits about 20-30 m from the water with a strip of cottonwoods/brush between; the east-side sites are 100 m+ from the channel across a broad sand bar, and the shop tags no RV site as near water. I could not confirm open ground for the south-tip sites under the canopy, so no change (never upgraded).

PIN (49.08280,-111.61850): at the west end of the campground by the registration/store area; the loops' centre is about 49.0825,-111.6162 (~165 m E) and the page's directions point 49.082232,-111.615197 - within tolerance, no move.
